speaker: thabo_mokoena
headline: A RIGHT IS ONLY REAL WHEN THE MATERIAL CHAIN CLOSES.
deck: Policy can promise relief, but workers experience the system through each handoff between recognition, administration and payment.
quote: The paperwork is not the outcome. The outcome is whether relief reaches the household before the damage deepens.
facts: Every extra handoff creates another place for delay.
A stalled payment pushes debt and care costs downstream.
The final household transfer is the material test.

chain.label: CLAIM
chain.note: The worker enters the administrative system.

chain.label: REVIEW
chain.note: Files, proof and eligibility are checked.

chain.label: HOUSEHOLD
chain.note: Relief matters only when it arrives.

takeaway: A benefit that stops inside administration is not relief; it is an unpaid promise.
